# `terminal.move`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/terminal.move.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`terminal.move`: terminals of one strip put before another terminal of the strip, or at its end (WP-S2.07 §5.2,
D4).

Let T be the strip's terminals in (`seq`, ID) order. The new order O is T without the moved terminals, with them
(in their T order) inserted directly before `before` (absent: at the end). For every index i from the first to the
last where T and O differ, the terminal at index i of O takes the old `seq` of the one at index i of T: the
sequence values of the changed range are permuted (the rule of `page.reorder`). Groups, accessories and
designations stay, so a moved terminal takes the group of its new place. Rejected: no terminal; a terminal listed
twice; a device that is not a terminal; terminals of two strips; a `before` that is one of the moved terminals or
not a terminal of their strip; an order that does not change. A missing device is `NotFound`. Cost Interactive, Outcome none.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `before` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no | `null` | The terminal of the same strip they are put before; absent or null: after the last terminal of the strip. |
| `terminals` | array of [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) (at least 1 item(s)) | yes |  | The terminal devices to move, at least one, all of one strip, in any order (they are taken in strip order). |

## Types

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
